text: Oscar Jacobson is one of two brands of Scandinavian Heritage, the renamed Oscar Jacobson Group, which sits in the portfolio of Mellby Gård. Mellby Gård describes itself as a family-owned, long-term investor founded by Rune Andersson in 1986; his son Johan Andersson became its chairman in 2025.
short: Oscar Jacobson belongs to Scandinavian Heritage, in the portfolio of the Andersson family's Mellby Gård group.

source.name: Mellby Gård: Company overview, Scandinavian Heritage
source.quote: The Oscar Jacobson Group, now Scandinavian Heritage, consists of the two Swedish fashion brands Oscar Jacobson and Filippa K.
source.note: The page is part of Mellby Gård's own group company overview; it shows a '90%* Share' figure with the footnote 'In Companies with 90%, Mellby Gårds share is >90%'.

additionalSources.name: Mellby Gård: Mellby Gård in brief
additionalSources.quote: In 2025, Johan Andersson, son of Rune Andersson, takes over as chairman of the board of Mellby Gård.
additionalSources.note: Same page: 'Mellby Gård was founded in 1986 when Rune Andersson acquired the Mellby Gård farm in Sösdala', and 'Mellby Gård is a family-owned, long-term investor'.
